reviews.text:
Such a great place to take your pets. I’ve taken both of my dogs here and they’ve been awesome! Super helpful and caring.

Leia (toy Aussie, red Merle) had a ruptured anal gland and they took care of her right away. Kona (toy Aussie, red tri) got his vaccines updated, a check up and nail trim. His nail trim was free - ask about it during your consult!! 🐾

The staff is wonderful, thank you for taking care of my babies and being informative. I appreciate that they don’t press you on services recommended. Also, when the dr asks about Leia (when I was there with Kona) is a plus in my book! 👏 😊

Come get your vaccines and check ups here for your fur babies! Thank you!!

Our family dog of 14 years, Lou, became severely ill. When we called our regular vet—a clinic we had used for years—we were told there was a four-month wait, even after explaining that Lou didn't have four months.

Desperate, we started calling around and, although not close by, found West Phoenix. From our first frantic call to the hardest moment at the end, the care we received from this team was simply unprecedented. We’ve owned pets for the last 40 years and I can honestly say we have never witnessed this level of clinical compassion.

We ultimately had to say goodbye to our little buddy. The staff didn't just handle a difficult procedure; they carried us through it. To top it off, we received a deeply personal, genuine end-of-life note that completely blew us away.

If you’re looking for a veterinary team that will treat your pets like family and you like a human being, this is the only place to go. They earned our loyalty for life.

Thank you West Valley!

The staff here are always so warm, welcoming, and caring. We've brought two of our dogs here, and both have received fabulous care. Everyone takes the time to answer questions and never makes you feel rushed.

We recently had to say goodbye to our 16-year-old Chihuahua, Hot Dog. The doctor and veterinary assistant showed incredible compassion during a difficult time. Giving us all the time we needed to say our final goodbye.

Our German Shepherd/Husky mix, Shelby, has also received amazing care. The team listened to all of our concerns, explained everything clearly, and prescribed her medicine.

The clinic is always clean, welcoming, and never has that overwhelming pet smell.

Veterinary care can be expensive, but I found the pricing here to be fair. They also offer third-party financing for those who qualify.

A special thank you to Betzahi, who has been wonderful during both of our visits. Her kindness, patience, and genuine love for animals truly stand out.

I can't recommend this clinic enough and can't see myself ever taking my animals elsewhere.

Went to the clinic for my baby girl! She was heavily constipated for a few days. Went over to this clinic, staff was very friendly and very knowledgeable. Everyone in the clinic and especially Yami, Maria and Ari. Thank you for everything!
P.s guess who is happy with the results!

Had a slight emergency that took a turn for the worst with my 8 year old pointer mix. I can’t thank this place enough for their empathy and kindness during one of the hardest times. Will be lifelong patients from here on out.
Absolutely loved our first visit to West Phoenix Veterinary Hospital! Friendly staff, helpful service, treats for pets, and even a free nail trim. Our cat felt right at home—highly recommend! 🐾💖

Took great care of my cat, Vulcan. He got out and was missing for two weeks and came back pretty beaten up. They’re gentle with him and care for him and that means a great deal. In the picture it’s me holding him with my welding gloves lol, he can be feisty.

Brought my cat in for a last minute appointment due to persistent diarrhea and excessive licking of her behind. The clinic is very clean, warm, and the staff are incredibly hospitable and sweet. The costs for her total work up were more affordable than expected and they offer SunBit payment plans for those who qualify. I appreciate the staff for being attentive, caring, and quick with my Stella girl :)
